verses.text: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David. Rescue me, O LORD, from evil men. Protect me from men of violence,

xrefs.text: who delivers me from my enemies. You exalt me above my foes; You rescue me from violent men.
Guard me, O LORD, from the hands of the wicked. Keep me safe from men of violence who scheme to make me stumble.
Deliver me, O my God, from the hand of the wicked, from the grasp of the unjust and ruthless.
How long, O LORD, must I call for help but You do not hear, or cry out to You, “Violence!” but You do not save?
Arise, O LORD, confront them! Bring them to their knees; deliver me from the wicked by Your sword,

verses.text: who devise evil in their hearts and stir up war all day long.

xrefs.text: They conspire, they lurk, they watch my steps while they wait to take my life.
Even on his bed he plots wickedness; he sets himself on a path that is not good; he fails to reject evil.
They hold fast to their evil purpose; they speak of hiding their snares. “Who will see them?” they say.
For they prepare their heart like an oven while they lie in wait; all night their anger smolders; in the morning it blazes like a flaming fire.
I am in favor of peace; but when I speak, they want war.

verses.text: They sharpen their tongues like snakes; the venom of vipers is on their lips. Selah

xrefs.text: Their venom is like the venom of a snake, like a cobra that shuts its ears,
“Their throats are open graves; their tongues practice deceit.” “The venom of vipers is on their lips.”
I am afraid, however, that just as Eve was deceived by the serpent’s cunning, your minds may be led astray from your simple and pure devotion to Christ.
In the end it bites like a snake and stings like a viper.
Each one betrays his friend; no one tells the truth. They have taught their tongues to lie; they wear themselves out committing iniquity.

verses.text: Guard me, O LORD, from the hands of the wicked. Keep me safe from men of violence who scheme to make me stumble.

xrefs.text: Let not the foot of the proud come against me, nor the hand of the wicked drive me away.
Deliver me, O my God, from the hand of the wicked, from the grasp of the unjust and ruthless.
My steps have held to Your paths; my feet have not slipped.
Keep me as the apple of Your eye; hide me in the shadow of Your wings
Though the wicked lie in wait for the righteous, and seek to slay them,

verses.text: The proud hide a snare for me; the cords of their net are spread along the path, and lures are set out for me. Selah

xrefs.text: For without cause they laid their net for me; without reason they dug a pit for my soul.
Although my spirit grows faint within me, You know my way. Along the path I travel they have hidden a snare for me.
Let a cry be heard from their houses when You suddenly bring raiders against them, for they have dug a pit to capture me and have hidden snares for my feet.
The arrogant have dug pits for me in violation of Your law.
Keep me from the snares they have laid for me, and from the lures of evildoers.

verses.text: I say to the LORD, “You are my God.” Hear, O LORD, my cry for help.

xrefs.text: I said to the LORD, “You are my Lord; apart from You I have no good thing.”
But I trust in You, O LORD; I say, “You are my God.”
The LORD is my portion; I have promised to keep Your words.
I cry to You, O LORD: “You are my refuge, my portion in the land of the living.”

This third I will bring through the fire; I will refine them like silver and test them like gold. They will call on My name, and I will answer them. I will say, ‘They are My people,’ and they will say, ‘The LORD is our God.’”

verses.text: O GOD the Lord, the strength of my salvation, You shield my head in the day of battle.

xrefs.text: My salvation and my honor rest on God, my strong rock; my refuge is in God.
He will call to Me, ‘You are my Father, my God, the Rock of my salvation.’

For the choirmaster. Of David the servant of the LORD, who sang this song to the LORD on the day the LORD had delivered him from the hand of all his enemies and from the hand of Saul. He said: I love You, O LORD, my strength.
He alone is my rock and my salvation. He is my fortress; I will never be shaken.
The eternal God is your dwelling place, and underneath are the everlasting arms. He drives out the enemy before you, giving the command, ‘Destroy him!’

verses.text: Grant not, O LORD, the desires of the wicked; do not promote their evil plans, lest they be exalted. Selah

xrefs.text: In pride the wicked pursue the needy; let them be caught in the schemes they devise.
Do not hand me over to the will of my foes, for false witnesses rise up against me, breathing out violence.
Now someone told David: “Ahithophel is among the conspirators with Absalom.” So David pleaded, “O LORD, please turn the counsel of Ahithophel into foolishness!”
if I had not dreaded the taunt of the enemy, lest their adversaries misunderstand and say: ‘Our own hand has prevailed; it was not the LORD who did all this.’”
He thwarts the schemes of the crafty, so that their hands find no success.

verses.text: May the heads of those who surround me be covered in the trouble their lips have caused.

xrefs.text: His trouble recoils on himself, and his violence falls on his own head.
A fool’s mouth is his ruin, and his lips are a snare to his soul.
An evil man is trapped by his rebellious speech, but a righteous man escapes from trouble.
He will bring upon them their own iniquity and destroy them for their wickedness. The LORD our God will destroy them.
So they hanged Haman on the gallows he had prepared for Mordecai. Then the fury of the king subsided.

verses.text: May burning coals fall on them; may they be thrown into the fire, into the miry pits, never to rise again.

xrefs.text: On the wicked He will rain down fiery coals and sulfur; a scorching wind will be their portion.
You will place them in a fiery furnace at the time of Your appearing. In His wrath the LORD will engulf them, and the fire will consume them.

But to the cowardly and unbelieving and abominable and murderers and sexually immoral and sorcerers and idolaters and all liars, their place will be in the lake that burns with fire and sulfur. This is the second death.
And if anyone was found whose name was not written in the Book of Life, he was thrown into the lake of fire.
The LORD thundered from heaven; the voice of the Most High resounded— hailstones and coals of fire.

verses.text: May no slanderer be established in the land; may calamity hunt down the man of violence.

xrefs.text: Evil will slay the wicked, and the haters of the righteous will be condemned.
Life and death are in the power of the tongue, and those who love it will eat its fruit.
Disaster pursues sinners, but prosperity is the reward of the righteous.
The one with a perverse heart finds no good, and he whose tongue is deceitful falls into trouble.
Woe to the wicked; disaster is upon them! For they will be repaid with what their hands have done.

verses.text: I know that the LORD upholds justice for the poor and defends the cause of the needy.

xrefs.text: For You have upheld my just cause; You sit on Your throne judging righteously.
then may You hear from heaven, Your dwelling place, their prayer and petition, and may You uphold their cause.
then may You hear from heaven their prayer and their plea, and may You uphold their cause.
Do not move an ancient boundary stone or encroach on the fields of the fatherless,
He took up the cause of the poor and needy, and so it went well with him. Is this not what it means to know Me?” declares the LORD.

verses.text: Surely the righteous will praise Your name; the upright will dwell in Your presence.

xrefs.text: For the LORD is righteous; He loves justice. The upright will see His face.
You have made known to me the path of life; You will fill me with joy in Your presence, with eternal pleasures at Your right hand.
After that, we who are alive and remain will be caught up together with them in the clouds to meet the Lord in the air. And so we will always be with the Lord.
Father, I want those You have given Me to be with Me where I am, that they may see the glory You gave Me because You loved Me before the foundation of the world.
Tell the righteous it will be well with them, for they will enjoy the fruit of their labor.
